tools.name: fractal_alerts_list
tools.description: List bounded owner alerts with actionable question/options, episode, target and evidence when present. Set agent_id to an exact canonical agent ID to select its published alerts. An empty page does not mean no work. Use fractal_alert_get only when further exact detail is needed.

agent_id.description: Exact canonical agent ID, not an alias or display name.

tools.name: fractal_alert_get
tools.description: Read one exact owner alert, including its episode and named answer options.

tools.name: fractal_alert_answer
tools.description: Execute one typed person-ask answer under write.assistant.answers using the alert's current episode and fence.

action_id.description: Unique per intended action, e.g. action/<short-slug>; reuse the same value on a retry

fence.description: Use the snapshot returned by the preceding read. Copy subject revisions from that snapshot to fence writes against changed resources.

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot id from the immediately preceding read result.

subject_revisions.description: Resource subject identifiers mapped to their opaque revision strings; omitted means no subject-specific revisions.

idempotency_key.description: 16-256 printable ASCII chars only (stricter than daemon byte-length bounds); reuse the exact value on retries of the same action

tools.name: fractal_agents_list
tools.description: List agent metadata. For a known canonical agent ID, set agent_id to avoid paging through the fleet. This does not read priorities or conversation content.

agent_id.description: Exact canonical agent ID, not an alias or display name.

tools.name: fractal_availability_get
tools.description: Read the grant person's own availability and current directive note. availability.status is the effective status (available or away; status_source says whether a manual override, valid until status_until, or device presence set it, or is unreported when no device has reported within 24 hours, which means available); raw device presence is never shown to assistants, so presence and presence_observed_at are always null; interruptions is all, urgent or none; deadline_clock is run, hold-routine or hold-all and says whether ask deadlines are paused. directive_note is the person's current standing instruction, or null. Its text is cut on a character boundary to fit max_response_bytes and directive_note_truncated is then true; read again with a larger max_response_bytes (up to 16384) for the whole note. The availability fields are never cut. While the person is away or interruptions is none, park blocking asks instead of interrupting them.

tools.name: fractal_conversations_list
tools.description: Discover source-bounded conversation metadata and read handles without conversation content. Each value.items entry supplies agent_id and session_id for fractal_conversation_timeline and a read object containing all fractal_conversation_read arguments (null when the bounded current timeline page has no readable text handle; use timeline to continue). Pass read unchanged to fractal_conversation_read; use value.page.next_cursor to page this list. Pages fit max_response_bytes; an item that cannot fit alone is named in the error.

tools.name: fractal_conversation_detail
tools.description: Read one agent's current conversation with bounded chat excerpts and revision-pinned read handles. Use agent_id from fractal_conversations_list; pass each non-null timeline item's read object unchanged to fractal_conversation_read. Content may be sensitive.

tools.name: fractal_conversation_timeline
tools.description: Page bounded chat excerpts and revision-pinned read handles. Copy agent_id and session_id from fractal_conversations_list to select the discovered session; omit session_id only to select the current session. Pass each non-null value.items[].read object unchanged to fractal_conversation_read, and use value.page.next_cursor only to continue this timeline. Content may be sensitive.

cursor.description: Copy value.page.next_cursor from the preceding timeline page; omit for the first page.

session_id.description: Copy the same conversation item's session_id to pin the discovered session; omitted selects the current session.

tools.name: fractal_conversation_search
tools.description: Search bounded plain conversation text snippets. Content may be sensitive.

tools.name: fractal_conversation_read
tools.description: Read one bounded revision-pinned conversation content range. Pass a non-null value.items[].read object from fractal_conversations_list or fractal_conversation_timeline unchanged; conversation detail also supplies timeline read handles. Each read object contains agent_id, session_id, reference, revision, start and end. Never invent handles or substitute a pagination cursor for a content reference. Content may contain sensitive material.

agent_id.description: Copy read.agent_id from a discovered conversation or timeline item.

end.description: Copy read.end, the exclusive range end.

reference.description: Copy read.reference, an opaque content reference, not a pagination cursor.

revision.description: Copy read.revision paired with this content reference to pin the source version.

session_id.description: Copy read.session_id from the same handle; do not infer from agent_id.

start.description: Copy read.start, the inclusive range start.

tools.name: fractal_message_send
tools.description: Send one exact message to any existing agent, authorized by write.assistant.messages and the ChatGPT confirmation card. Person recipients are refused.

action_id.description: Unique per intended action, e.g. action/<short-slug>; reuse the same value on a retry

fence.description: Use the snapshot returned by the preceding read. Copy subject revisions from that snapshot to fence writes against changed resources.

snapshot_id.description: The snapshot id from the immediately preceding read result.

subject_revisions.description: Resource subject identifiers mapped to their opaque revision strings; omitted means no subject-specific revisions.

idempotency_key.description: 16-256 printable ASCII chars only (stricter than daemon byte-length bounds); reuse the exact value on retries of the same action

tools.name: fractal_slo_list
tools.description: List every Fractal objective and budget row the daemon reports. An objective row (kind objective) states a service-level target, its current measurement, the window it is measured over, and remaining_percent: how much of its error budget is left. A budget row (kind budget, with an account) states an allowance, current use, the window until it resets, and how much remains, with a forecast when one is known. status and tone say whether the row is met and how urgent it is. Rows arrive in pages that fit max_response_bytes; while value.page.next_cursor is non-null, call again with that cursor to read the next rows.

tools.name: fractal_slo_history
tools.description: Chart what was left (remaining_percent) of one objective or budget row across a period. Copy id exactly from fractal_slo_list. since_ms and until_ms are Unix milliseconds (default: the last 24 hours, at most 7 days); steps (1 to 1000, default 120) is how many equal steps to answer in; each step holds its lowest reading and is null when nothing was read.

id.description: Exact objective or budget id from fractal_slo_list.

since_ms.description: Period start in Unix milliseconds; defaults to 24 hours before until_ms.

steps.description: Equal steps to answer in; defaults to 120.

until_ms.description: Period end in Unix milliseconds; defaults to now.
